svg.title: Plane variable-clause incidence graph of the 2 by 2 grid
svg.desc: The four grid points x00, x10, x01, x11 at the corners of a square. Each of the four grid edges is replaced by a product gadget with its clause A on the left of the edge, oriented rightward or upward, and z, B, C on its right. The gadgets bound one inner cell face and the outer face.
